references: ref/maneuver.ts (320-bit closed form, analytic crossing time)
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0) except where a value is encoded as {"$number": "-0"}.

method.semantics: docs/architecture/contracts-v1.md revision 4 §8.3, §11.3 D1–D5, §11.4 P2 (t_s = maneuver time), P6 (post-maneuver segment only)
method.escapeRule: ESCAPE_TRAJECTORY iff the post-maneuver specific energy is not negative beyond its rounding uncertainty (D1, D2). Cases are ≥ 1e-6·(v²/2 + μ/r) from zero (record §7 VT-16 case-selection margin) except the exactly-parabolic case, which is in the near-parabolic class by construction.
method.intersectionRule: REFERENCE_SPHERE_INTERSECTION iff the radius is ≤ R_ref at some time in [m, D], inclusive (D3, D4), decided from the post-maneuver conic: r_p⁺ ≤ R_ref and the analytic time to first reach R_ref (Kepler / hyperbolic Kepler equation) ≤ D − m. Cases: |r_p⁺ − R_ref| ≥ 1e-6 R_ref (record) and |t_c − (D − m)| ≥ 5 % of the span (chosen here).
